title: Hindustan Coca-Cola IPO filings reveal Thums Up is outperforming Coke across 10 key Indian states
summary: Coca-Cola bottler Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed for an IPO, structured entirely as an offer for sale. The company serves around 1.7 million retail outlets and sells 41 beverages across three categories. Coca-Cola holds 60% of HCCH, with Jubilant Beverages owning the remaining 40%.

direction_reasons: FUNDRAISING cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
